# Teck Leong Industries Pte Ltd — copper.asia

> Singapore stockist of copper, brass, bronze and tungsten copper since 1933.
> Cutting to size, serving customers across Asia. B2B supplier — request a quote,
> no online shop.

## About

- Founded in 1933.
- Authorised distributor of NIBCO fittings.
- Serves customers across Asia from Singapore.

## Products

- Copper & Copper Alloys
- Brass & Brass Alloys
- Bronze & Bronze Alloys
- Brass Fittings
- [Bronze Fittings & Flanges](https://copper.asia/products/Bronze-Fittings-&-Flanges)
- Copper Pipe & Copper Tube
- [Copper and Cast Copper Alloy Fittings & Flanges](https://copper.asia/products/Copper-and-Cast-Copper-Alloy-Fittings-&-Flanges)
- Aluminium, Engineering Plastic & Zinc
- Lead Sheet and Radiation Shielding Products
- Metal Fabrication Services
- Nails, Perforated Sheet, Wire & Wire Mesh
- [Stainless Steel](https://copper.asia/products/Stainless-Steel)
- [Shim Plates](https://copper.asia/products/Shim-Plates)
- [EDM Graphite](https://copper.asia/products/EDM-Graphite)
- [Shelving & Racking System](https://copper.asia/products/Shelving-&-Racking-System)
